semantics: Exact names/aliases precede partial matches; positive local pro-history precedes zero/unknown within each group, ties are stable and not ordered by N.
One verified local candidate with positive history may fill an ambiguous review draft; ambiguity and manual whole-five confirmation remain.
Explicit numeric lookup returns only that account; saved global links and manual/cleared drafts remain authoritative.
Local counts require completed earlier pro maps, verified identity and nonconflicting ingest; pubs/future maps excluded. Counts are descriptive, not Elo eligibility.
Unknown history is not zero; zero local maps may mean history not loaded. No extra external history requests.
Only found candidates are ranked. A wholly different nickname still needs numeric lookup, recognized link or observed alias. No automated Dota2ProTracker retrieval.
initialFailure: New API fixture reused an intentionally conflicting account from a previous case; replaced by two verified accounts, preserved stable-order reversal. 24/25 initial, 25/25 final.
